quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: AstraZeneca announces new strategic collaboration with (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AstraZeneca entered into a new strategic drug discovery collaboration and licensing agreement with insitro, which the release calls a leading AI therapeutics company: insitro will apply its Virtual Human AI platform to identify causal disease biology in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) and cardiomyopathies and advance AstraZeneca-nominated targets from discovery through to development candidate, while AstraZeneca uses its clinical development and regulatory expertise to advance the resulting medicines and has exclusive worldwide rights to selected programmes. insitro receives an upfront payment of $40 million and is eligible for up to approximately $1.46 billion in potential development and commercial milestones, plus potential single digit royalties on global commercial sales. Sharon Barr (EVP, Head of BioPharmaceuticals R&D): the collaboration underscores AstraZeneca's commitment to 'maximising the potential of cutting-edge AI to tackle the root cause of disease'.
quarterly_data.figure: $40 million upfront; up to approximately $1.46 billion in milestones; single digit royalties
